entities.name: Església de la Santa Creu de Canillo
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Església de la Santa Creu de Canillo is a small church located in Canillo, Andorra. It is a heritage property registered in the Cultural Heritage of Andorra. It was built in the 17-18th century.
